fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of sorted unique modified/untracked paths, NUL, full file bytes, NUL; excludes tests/evidence/; includes preserved ADR-0024 and B1-B5 work

scope.current_trip: all active Payment/Invoice assignments, active TripEvidence links and active auxiliary material for included invoices; not management-page rows or inferred links
scope.fixed_reimbursement: immutable item, review and captured auxiliary-material snapshot; excludes current TripEvidence and later fact/material changes

database.source: existing postgres:17; no pull or download
database.isolation: dedicated internal network; no host database port; synthetic data only
tested: 201 active assigned Documents are returned completely beyond the management-page boundary
current Trip and fixed Reimbursement scopes do not mix; shared Documents are deduplicated without losing references
fixed snapshots survive status transition, correction, move, deletion and later material changes without hash drift
historical uncaptured material and Review identities remain explicitly null/warned and are never backfilled
Owner/Finance permission, Viewer/Reviewer rejection, tenant isolation and user/session binding
strict path/query/JSON/CSRF validation, preview conflict, missing/corrupt object whole-package failure and safe errors
one-time download, HEAD/Range rejection, cancellation, expiry, disconnect, service close and two-slot concurrency
full synthetic HTTP journey from failed AI/manual review through correction, Trip, auxiliary material, Reimbursement and exact ZIP bytes

statement_coverage.method: unique statement blocks with any positive atomic count; existing layer boundaries unchanged

streaming_archive.implementation: ZIP Store, fixed 32 KiB copy buffer and unlinked owner-only file descriptor under export-spool

authenticated_restore.limit: focused nonempty regression fixtures, not a new 1000-Document exercise

web.visual_review: current Trip desktop/dark and fixed Reimbursement narrow/light panels inspected; responsive synthetic captures cover both scopes
covered: 201-file complete preview and native attachment download without Blob/arrayBuffer
native download expiry or authorization error remains explicit and the source page does not claim save success
preview 409 and unavailable object never expose a download
prepare cancellation, late response isolation and failed cancel retry
scope switching, focus restoration, four-role capability hiding and responsive layout
web.scope: production-built components with synthetic Mock API plus separate actual PostgreSQL-backed HTTP tests; not a deployed runtime browser release gate

failure_history.cause: new-window first navigation was not intercepted by the original Page route and a non-attachment response could be silently named as a file
failure_history.resolution: route the BrowserContext, retain server Content-Disposition, remove the client download attribute and verify success plus explicit error-window behavior

failure_history.cause: 201 complete AI/manual workflow fixtures pushed the reviews package over its existing 60-second limit
failure_history.resolution: bulk-seed the same constrained PostgreSQL Document/Claim/Review/Fact/Assignment graph for this database-query boundary; final package and full suite pass without raising timeouts

failure_history.cause: the first successful functional run omitted the required cross-package coverpkg instrumentation
failure_history.resolution: discard the invalid coverage values and rerun the complete uncached suite with the authoritative coverage command

failure_history.cause: the stock PostgreSQL image exposes tools at different absolute paths than the application release image
failure_history.resolution: confirm PostgreSQL 17.11 command paths in the existing image and rerun both native tests successfully

failure_history.cause: path-ID contract constraints were weaker than the domain, download errors lacked an explicit browser case, and fixed Reimbursement manifests used the mutable status version
failure_history.resolution: align OpenAPI constraints, add the native error case and bind fixed manifests to submission snapshot version 1; all affected and complete gates pass

failure_history.cause: the deployed representative-flow specification correctly requires runtime credentials unavailable in this Mock API slice
failure_history.resolution: run all 13 credential-free Mock API specifications explicitly; do not claim the deployed representative-flow gate

review.scan_limit: known key/private-key patterns, exact exercise-secret comparison and scoped diff review; not universal secret detection
review.read_only_agents: backend snapshot/security/resource review and frontend contract/download/accessibility review; main agent implemented and revalidated findings

resources.swap: pre-existing 3898 MiB used; no expanded limits or OOM retry

plan_completion.statement: B1-B6 business-completion plan is locally complete; this is not a claim that every separately excluded product capability is implemented

not_performed: real Provider call, image transmission or formal model accuracy evaluation
real mailbox, external account or deployed representative-flow integration
new release-image runtime performance, Lighthouse or production deployment gates
